title.en: The Medium-Project Shortlist Is Electric 40, Electric 50, Diesel 40 and Diesel 50
title.zh: 中型项目短名单是电动40、电动50、柴油40和柴油50

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai names Electric 40, Electric 50, Diesel 40 and Diesel 50 for a medium-project comparison. Match pipeline length and power type, then inquire.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把电动40、电动50、柴油40和柴油50列为中型项目对照。先对照管长和动力形式，再询盘。

h1.en: Use the Four-Page Medium Shortlist as Four Orders
h1.zh: 把四页中型短名单当成四张订单

directAnswer.en: The selection note at Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai says to compare Electric 40, Electric 50, Diesel 40 and Diesel 50 against pipeline length and power type. Electric 40 prints 45 kW and 21 m³/h, with fine-stone 120 m / 360 m. Electric 50 prints 55 kW and 26 m³/h, with three stone rows. Diesel 40 prints 4108 / 66 kW and 26 m³/h. Diesel 50 prints 6105 / 99 kW and 30 m³/h at 150 m / 450 m. Pick the path whose power the site will actually use.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械（邢台）的选型说明要求按管长和动力形式对照电动40、电动50、柴油40和柴油50。电动40印 45 kW、21 m³/h，细石 120 m / 360 m。电动50印 55 kW、26 m³/h，并有三行石子。柴油40印 4108 / 66 kW、26 m³/h。柴油50印 6105 / 99 kW、30 m³/h、150 m / 450 m。选择现场真正会使用其动力的那条路径。

body.en: Electric 50 and Diesel 40 both print 26 m³/h. One is a 55 kW motor with three stone rows. The other is a 66 kW diesel with a single 120 m / 360 m pair. Output equality is not an order.
body.zh: 电动50和柴油40都印 26 m³/h。一台是 55 kW 电机、三行石子。另一台是 66 kW 柴油机、一组 120 m / 360 m。输送量相同不是一张订单。

heading.en: Electric Low Pressure 40 is outside this sentence
heading.zh: 电动低压40不在这句话里

body.en: The medium note does not name Electric Low Pressure 40. That page is 37 kW and 12–15 m³/h. Add it only as its own path if you are comparing 37 kW on purpose.
body.zh: 中型说明没有点名电动低压40。那一页是 37 kW、12–15 m³/h。只有你有意对照 37 kW 时，才把它作为自己的路径加上。

body.en: One path, the distance row, grid or diesel, to [/en/contact/](/en/contact/). No list price.
body.zh: 一条路径、距离行、电网或柴油，发到 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/)。没有标价。

answer.en: No. Electric 60 is on the long-distance note.
answer.zh: 不包含。电动60在长距离说明里。

answer.en: Electric 40. The electric mixer’s main motor is also 45 kW, plus a 14 kW mixer motor, and it is not this shortlist.
answer.zh: 电动40。电动搅拌泵的主电机也是 45 kW，另加 14 kW 搅拌电机，而且它不在这份短名单上。
